claims.text: CharacterMeet facilitates iterative character construction for creative writers.
Writers using CharacterMeet alternate between writing and personalized exploration through visual idea generation.
Visuals and audio in CharacterMeet enhance user immersion during the creative writing process.
CharacterMeet allows creative writers to progressively manifest story characters through conversation while customizing context, appearance, voice, and background images.

evidence.description: Findings from a user study (N=14) with creative writers showed that the system supported iterative character construction stages.
User study participants, including those with typically linear writing workflows, alternated between writing and idea visualization on CharacterMeet.
Participant observations and feedback indicated that visual and audio features enhanced immersion.
CharacterMeet prototype implementation allows customizing context, character appearance, voice, and background image alongside conversational avatar interaction.

methodologies.name: CharacterMeet User Evaluation
methodologies.description: A user study examining the thinking and usage patterns of creative writers interacting with an LLM-powered avatar prototype system.
